resources.string: Factory driving assistance
Apollo on a compatible FREE 318 · setup stays in the factory controls.
Set up in the vehicle
In Vehicle → Driving assistance, complete the setup shown for your equipment. Enable TLC before NOA and select a supported navigation route. Gray means standby. Blue means active.
Check this head unit
Read the installed software identities and the factory request cache. Vehicle activation still needs verified equipment, controller feedback and independent recovery.
